pilot_build: python3 scripts/vadd.py build --family muldiv149 --output corpus --compiler clang-22 --build-jobs 2 --link ../user.ld --units-file ../PILOT_UNITS.json
full: nohup taskset -c 28-31 nice -n 10 bash launch-full.sh > launcher.log 2>&1 < /dev/null
frozen_script_identity: sha256sum scripts/*.py launch-full.sh > FREEZE.sha256; sha256sum -c FREEZE.sha256 before and after
completion: Full launcher writes STAGE_STATUS.json and COMPLETE; no additional tmux signal sent here
